name: at holds when an accepted fix is behind the drawing

steps.why: Fix advances 50 m in 10 s, setting 5 m/s.
Five seconds at 5 m/s draws 25 m beyond the fix.
The accepted fix is at 160 m, behind the 175 m drawn point.
At the second report time the old 5 m/s trajectory has eased for one second, reaching 179.2 m; the new 160 m fix is behind it, so hold.
